purpose: Index of constitutional and operational rules the Tutor and runtime may cite. Not a substitute for CONSTITUTION.md.

rules.title: Truth over claims
rules.statement: No engineering statement is accepted without verifiable evidence; unverified claims must be marked NOT VERIFIED.

rules.title: Sole phase writer
rules.statement: All persisted mission phase mutations MUST go through AuthorityTruthSource.commitTransition.

rules.title: Human direction gate
rules.statement: Transitions requiring HITL must present a valid receipt; missing receipt denies and leaves state unchanged.

rules.title: FDIR safe mode
rules.statement: When FDIR kill switch is tripped, mission close and real integrations are blocked.

rules.title: Fundacion and main frozen
rules.statement: PRJ-FUNDACION Δ=0; merge to main and network/credentials require explicit separate gates.

rules.title: Local fixture receipt class
rules.statement: LOCAL_BOUNDED fixture receipts are MEASURED local governance aids, not production human identity proof.

rules.title: Local schema contracts
rules.statement: Mission OS local MVP validates direction and mission-package against local schemas before plan advancement.

rules.title: Organic routing gate
rules.statement: Classify work as DIRECT, DELEGATED_DIRECT, or SDD before spawning heavy SDD ceremony. File/diff size alone must not force SDD. Accidental SDD spawn is fail-closed unless explicitSddRequest, acceptedProposal, or forceSddOverride.

rules.title: Strict TDD evidence receipts
rules.statement: Apply-complete claims require auditable RED→GREEN receipts (TRIANGULATE/REFACTOR when Strict TDD or tests exist). Missing receipts cannot claim VERIFIED and cannot pass the verify gate.

rules.title: RDD review is informational
rules.statement: Independent or adversarial review does not authorize delivery, write, merge, release, or Fundacion mutation. Delivery remains human / HITL / write-barrier.
